title: The Emotion Master
description: A tale where your emotions shape the story's path.

start.text: In a world where emotions hold magical power, you discover you're an Emotion Master - someone who can channel feelings into reality. As you step into the Academy of Emotional Arts, your journey begins...

1A.ending: The Eternal Spring: Your happiness brought perpetual bloom to the world.

1B.ending: The Joy Epidemic: Your happiness became contagious, changing society forever.

1C.ending: The Laughing Storm: Your joy became one with nature itself.

1D.ending: The Never-Ending Celebration: Your happiness created an eternal carnival.

2A.ending: The Cleansing Flood: Your tears washed away the old world.

2B.ending: The Echo of Melancholy: Your words changed hearts forever.

2C.ending: The Beautiful Darkness: Your sadness became the stars.

2D.ending: The Eternal Song: Your sorrow became the world's most beautiful melody.

3A.ending: The Arsenal of Change: Your anger reshaped civilization.

3B.ending: The New Dawn: Your passion ignited a movement.

3C.ending: The Storm King: Your anger became nature's fury.

3D.ending: The Fortress of Solitude: Your anger protected what matters most.

4A.ending: The Gateway Master: Your wonder opened paths to new worlds.

4B.ending: The Wonder Weaver: Your surprise became pure magic.

4C.ending: The Truth Seeker: Your curiosity unveiled the universe's mysteries.

4D.ending: The Reality Shaper: Your amazement reshaped existence itself.
